definitions.explanation: Easily peelable paper tape. Besides its original use in painting, decorative versions (often shortened to マスキングテープ／マステ) are popular in Japan for crafts and journaling.

examples.japanese: マスキングテープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧マスキングテープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{窓枠|まどわく}→窓枠：15667_madowaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧マスキングテープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}って→貼る：10447_haru⟧おいた。
examples.english: Before painting the wall, I put masking tape along the window frames.

notes:
From English "masking tape," commonly clipped to マステ. In Japan it has become a craft item in its own right, with countless colors and patterns of ⟦{和紙|わし}→和紙：02268_washi⟧-based decorative tape.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マスキングテープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to apply masking tape
- マスキングテープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧: to fasten lightly with masking tape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦セロテープ→セロテープ：27931_seroteepu⟧: cellophane tape — clear and meant to hold permanently
- ⟦ガムテープ→ガムテープ：27387_gamuteepu⟧: packing tape — thick and strong, hard to remove cleanly
